description: Golden STE vs Non-STE example pairs for regression tests. Unofficial — not affiliated with ASD. Some pairs adapted from ASD-STE100 Issue 9 writing-rule examples; others hand-crafted for Tier-1 / Tier-2 / Tier-3 coverage.

pairs.non_ste: Utilize the approved procedure.
pairs.notes: utilize is unapproved; use is approved (1:1 safe fix).

pairs.non_ste: Commence the test.
pairs.notes: commence → start (single alternative).

pairs.non_ste: Abandon the procedure.
pairs.notes: abandon has multiple alternatives; not a safe auto-fix.
Approved STE sentence; function words and seeded technical noun valve.
In Issue 9, approximately is an approved adverb.

pairs.non_ste: Remove the cover and then carefully inspect each of the internal components for any signs of damage before you continue with work.
pairs.ste: Remove the cover. Inspect the components for damage.
pairs.notes: Procedural sentences max 20 words.

pairs.non_ste: The system gives a clear indication of the pressure value when the operator starts the secondary pump during the daily check sequence on the ground and also records the result in the log.
pairs.ste: The system shows the pressure when you start the secondary pump.
pairs.notes: Descriptive sentences max 25 words.

pairs.non_ste: Remove the cover and clean the surface.
pairs.ste:
1. Remove the cover.
2. Clean the surface.
pairs.notes: One instruction per procedural sentence.

pairs.non_ste: Set the clearance to 10mm.
pairs.notes: Prefer a space between number and unit.

pairs.ste: Make sure that the valve can operate.
pairs.notes: Adapted from Issue 9 STE example; valve is a technical noun.

pairs.non_ste: Test the system for leaks.
pairs.ste: Do the leak test of the system.
pairs.notes: Adapted from Issue 9; 'test' is approved as noun, not as verb.

pairs.non_ste: Make sure that the valve is operable.
pairs.ste: Make sure that the valve can operate.
pairs.notes: Adapted from Issue 9 writing rules.

pairs.non_ste: Do not enter the engine test area without approval.
pairs.ste: Do not go into the engine test area without approval.
pairs.notes: Adapted from Issue 9; enter unapproved in this sense.

pairs.non_ste: If you detect broken wires, repair them.
pairs.ste: If you find broken wires, repair them.
pairs.notes: Adapted from Issue 9; detect unapproved.

pairs.non_ste: 1. The temperature must be adjusted.
pairs.notes: Tier-2: modal passive in a numbered procedural step.

pairs.non_ste: 1. The valve is closed by the operator.
pairs.notes: Verbal passive with agent in a numbered step (Rule 3.6).
Imperative-compliant procedural step.

pairs.non_ste: The operator is adjusting the linkage.
pairs.notes: Progressive main verb is not an approved STE tense (Rule 3.2).

pairs.non_ste: The operator has closed the valve.
pairs.notes: Present perfect is not approved (Rule 3.4).

pairs.non_ste: Remove the fuel pump inlet pressure sensor.
pairs.notes: Multi-word noun longer than three words (Rule 2.1).
Three-word multi-word noun is allowed.

pairs.ste: 1. Examine all parts of the disassembled unit for damage.
pairs.notes: Past participle as adjective (Rule 3.3) must not raise STE-PASSIVE.

pairs.non_ste: Grease the fasteners.
pairs.notes: Grease as verb unapproved; grease as technical noun OK.

pairs.non_ste: Utilize this tool.
pairs.notes: Safe-fix candidate: utilize → use.
Fully approved short STE sentence.

pairs.ste: Make sure the system is safe.
pairs.notes: Approved STE sentence with closed-class words.
Correctly spaced unit should not raise STE-UNITS-FORMAT.

pairs.non_ste: Remove the panel from the unit. It is damaged.
pairs.ste: Remove the panel from the unit. The panel is damaged.
pairs.notes: Ambiguous 'it' with multiple same-number noun candidates (Tier-3 WARNING).

pairs.ste: The pump supplies pressure. It also supplies fluid.
pairs.notes: Clear singular subject antecedent; STE-PRONOUN-AMBIG must not fire.

pairs.non_ste: It supplies pressure to the system.
pairs.ste: The pump supplies pressure to the system.
pairs.notes: Weak description opener (pronoun start); topic rule is description-only.

pairs.ste: The pump supplies pressure to the system.
pairs.notes: Clear topic noun in the first sentence.

pairs.non_ste: Check the pressure.
pairs.ste: Do a check of the pressure.
pairs.notes: Approved noun 'check' used as verb → high-confidence POS ERROR.
Approved verb used as verb; no STE-POS-MISMATCH.
